baseline.toolchain: node 22 / vite 7 production build with terser (npm run build)
baseline.note: Budgets are the measured size plus roughly 15-20% headroom. Raise one only with a recorded reason in the pull request that raises it; a bundle that grows past its budget is a product decision, not a build detail. Reseed with 'eng/Check-BundleBudget.ps1 -ReportOnly' after an intentional increase.

groups.description: Directory placeholders kept in source control so wwwroot/js and wwwroot/css/themes exist before the build writes into them.
The single ES module vite emits from igc-grid-lite-entry.js (dynamic imports inlined). Loaded on every page that uses the grid.
Shipped for debuggability. Never requested unless devtools are open, so no gzip budget.
Prebuilt component themes copied from igniteui-webcomponents by the vite plugin. Consumers reference one.

totals.description: Worst case over the wire for a page using a themed grid.
Everything shipped under _content/IgniteUI.Blazor.GridLite, including source maps.
